verses.text: Yuj chi', a tzin na'a, manhxo ol in k'och t'ayex t'a skal kusk'olal.
Tato sb'at wak'och he kusk'olal, ¿machto junok ol ak'anxi in tzalajk'olal? Yuj chi', malaj in gana sb'at wak'och he kusk'olal yujto a exnhej syal eyak'an sniwanil in k'o'ol.

Yuj chi', icha chi' wutejnak walanb'at t'ayex t'a jun in carta, yujto malaj in gana b'at wak'och he kusk'olal. Yujto a ex wal smoj eyak'an in tzalajk'olal. Swak'anoch yipok in k'o'ol, yujto tzin na'a, tato sja in tzalajk'olal, ol japax he tzalajk'olal wet'ok.

Ayik in tz'ib'annakb'at jun in carta chi' t'ayex, te ochnak in ilk'olal eyu'uj. Ochnak wal pitz'an t'a in k'o'ol, hanhejtona' ok'nak in pax eyu'uj. Palta manh yujok wak'anoch he kusk'olal in tz'ib'ejnakb'ati. In tz'ib'ejnakb'ati yik tzeyojtakejeli to te xajan ex wu'uj.
Malaj in gana tzin ek' t'a yib'anh in b'oan yaj jun tik, palta a jun winh ak'jinak och ko kusk'olal, manhok innhej kusnak in, ayex pax kusnak ex janik' wet'ok.
Ha jun yahelal ix eyak'och t'a yib'anh winh ayik ix he molb'an he b'a, k'okb'ilokab'i.
Haxo tikne'ik, más wach' tzeyak' niwank'olal winh. Tzeyak'anpax sniwanil sk'ol winh, yik wach' max te juwiel winh yuj kusk'olal.
Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayex to tze ch'ox he wach'k'olal t'a winh.
Yuj jun chi' in tz'ib'ejnakb'at jun in carta t'ayex, yik wach' tzex wak' prowal. Yujto in gana swojtakejeli tato yel tze k'anab'ajej tas swala'.

Yuj chi' tato tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh jun winh chi', a inxo pax tik, ol wak'pax niwank'olal winh. Tato a in swak' niwank'olal winh, ha t'a yol sat Cristo swak' niwank'olal syal chi', palta yuj he wach'ilok a ex tik.
Icha chi' swutej, yik wach' max onh yak' ganar winh Satanás, yujto kojtakxo tas snib'ej winh t'ayonh.
Ayik in k'och t'a chonhab' Troas, yik swalanel jun wach' ab'ix yik Cristo, ilchaj wu'uj to a Kajal Jesús b'oan yaj masanil yik swalel slolonel.
Palta och in ilk'olal, yujto maj ilchaj winh kuk'tak Tito wuj ta'. Yuj chi' walkan kil ko b'a t'a heb' ay chi' ta', in kotxi ta', in ja t'a yol yik Macedonia tik.

Palta kak'ek yuj diosal t'a Dios, yujto masanil tiempo ha' tzonh ik'anoch tzak'an yet' Cristo Jesús yik scheklajeli to ha' ix ak'an ganar. Ku'uj spukaxb'at yab'ixal Cristo t'a junjun lugar, icha spukaxb'at sjab' junok tas suk'uk'i sjab'.
Icha sjab' stab'il junok tas suk'uk'i sjab' syak' Cristo t'a Dios, ich onh ta' ayik tzek' kalanel yab'ixal. Spukaxb'at t'a skal heb' skolchaji yet' pax t'a skal heb' wanto satek'i.

Ayik skalan t'a heb' wan satek'i, lajan yab'ixal chi' icha sjab' junok tas tzonh cham yuj. Haxo tato ha t'a heb' wan skolchaj skaleli, lajan yab'ixal chi' icha junok tas te suk'uk'i sjab' t'a heb', sch'oxan paxi to ol scha sk'inal heb'. Yuj chi', ¿mach wal junok syal yalanel jun ab'ix tik?

Ha onh tik, manh yujok kak'an ganar t'a spatik slolonel Dios, yuj chi' tzek' kaleli, icha syutej sb'a juntzanhxo heb'. Niwanok tzek' yal heb', palta soman syutej heb' yalani. Palta a onh tik, yel skala', yujto ha Dios ix ak'an kopisio tik. Ha t'a yichanh Dios skala' yujto yik onhxo Cristo heyet'ok.
